data_source: Local source files read in episode: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/master/data/2018-12-04/medium_datasci.csv
analysis_intent: Predict or estimate outcomes in Medium articles using cleaned features, exploratory analysis, and model evaluation
external_dependencies: remote file or API download detected in code
execution_notes: interactive `View()` calls are present and should be skipped or replaced in automated runs
fails_when: outcome column is missing or near-zero variance
training set is too small for the number of predictors
text is multilingual without language detection
join key has trailing whitespace or case inconsistency — produces unexpected NAs
irregular time intervals inflate or deflate apparent trends
works_when: outcome column is clearly defined and has sufficient variance
features can be engineered from existing columns without external joins
text is long-form English and benefits from word-level decomposition
time dimension is regular and spans multiple periods with meaningful change

steps: Tokenize text, remove stopwords, compute frequencies
Build 3-4 core ggplot charts telling the main story
Split with initial_split(), create v-fold CV
Quarto doc: medium_articles_report.qmd with params for data year
Hero chart: single best visualisation at 1200×628 (social media ratio)
Instagram carousel: 5 slides (hook → data → insight → method → CTA)
Shiny widget or Observable/D3 for one interactive element
TheDataShrink™ post template: title, 3 bullets, hashtags, link to episode page
